en:
But... No matter how many times you add zero
to zero... It's still zero.

We'll do it.
We'll put a stop to your plans.
Think you will entertain us?
Well then, farewell everyone...

We're about t'face our toughest
opponent yet...

Kiryu-san, we're counting on you here.
It'd be awful if Onomichi lost this field.

It's fine for us old guys, but the kids who dream
of going pro someday would be crushed...
No matter what, we can't let that happen...
I jus' heard the news.
Hamana!

Fer what it's worth, you've got my faith too,
considerin' how ya surpassed us like y'did.
C'mon... Y'gotta stop him for all of us!

That said... We'd wear Warriors colors too if it
means fightin' them off. Whaddaya think of that?

Ooh! We could combine our three teams and win
with one big super team! What do you think?

I appreciate the gesture... 
But I'll have to pass.
What? Why?

We'd be no different from them if all we
did was cherry-pick the best players.

I'll put my faith in the same team that
carried us all to where we're standing.

I want to play with those guys 'til the end.
And I think... We can beat them if we stick together.

Mhm... That's really great.
Too good, even. Yeah...
You're too damn cool, Kiryu-san...

Still... We need to practice harder and
come as our best if we want to beat them.

If you want to help... Then practice with us.
Take us to the top by training alongside us.
You got it. We can handle that, Kiryu-san.
Good plan!
Nice... Let's all work together t'take 'em down!

We'll protect this field of memories
for the future of Onomichi's baseball!

(Kanamizawa Gorgeous...
We have to win this!)

It's finally time for our deciding game
against Kanamizawa Gorgeous...!
It seems everyone's gathered.
There you are... Kanamizawa.

You promised, if we beat you,
you'll stop tryin' to buy this field!

Of course.
That is, <font_kind=yakuza_italic>if</font_kind> you win.

I doubt a team as expensive as mine...
could lose against a ragtag bunch of amateurs.
Anything can happen in baseball, right?

That's right! We may be the underdogs, but we share
a bond that a team motivated only by money doesn't!

Baseball is all about synergy among your team.
That's why we won't lose to you guys!

A bond, is it?
How absurd...

Synergy, your bond as a team... We'll crush it all
using the world's only true value... Money.
I'm getting excited for the first pitch...
Kiryu-san... We can't lose this one!

Just let me know when you're ready!
For the final showdown... We can't hold back!

Kiryu-san! This is it, our game against Gorgeous...
Let's blow them away!
Damn... They're so strong...

It seems this is as far as that so-called
"bond" can take you.

You can't expect to beat pure cash
with the power of emotions.

And since we won...
The field acquisition plan carries on.

If you still want to stop me, I suggest you
try again soon... Show me this "bond."

I'm real damn frustrated
that they're such a cut above us...

But we can't give up now!
Let's take them on again!
We... We... We...
We woooooooooon!

We won!
We... are Onomichi's strongest!
Yeah, well done, everyone.
All riiiiiight!
Yaaaaaay!
Hell yeeeaaah!

Impossible...
I invested so much money into this team.

I gathered world-class players, and yet we lost...
How...? I don't understand...

Baseball... is a team sport.
Y'can't win unless the team is united.

We used t'be a pathetic team with no
synergy at all... 'Til Kiryu-san showed up.

Since he joined us, we grew in numbers,
and we played as a unit.

I don't deny that we were pretty rough 'round
the edges... But our bond is unbreakable now.

I'm so glad t'be a part of this team...
I'm so happy I got t'play with these guys...

And... I bet that's how we all feel inside,
and that thought makes me way happy!

Our bond... That's how we won the game!
Well, I think so anyway!
Your... Bond...?

I can't believe such a thing could
determine winning or losing...

But because it can...
Isn't that what makes baseball so fun?

You do like baseball, don't you?
Enough to build your own team, anyway.
Then... Don't you get that on some level?

We lose this game.
As promised, I won't buy the field.
Yay!

However, that doesn't mean I've given up
on the title of Onomichi's best team.

We'll train even harder...
And come back to beat you next time!
Sure... Any time you want to play.
Alright, guys, let's call it day.

I'm rather famished, actually... Let's all forge
a bond over a luxurious supper, shall we?
[Yeah! Hooo!]
[Wow! Great!]
[Kanamizawa! I love you!]
Bond! Bond!
What weirdos...

Kiryu-san... I've said this before,
but thank you so much!

If y'hadn't joined us...
I think our team would've disbanded.
I'm truly glad that you joined our team!

No, I had a lot of fun, and I gained
some new experiences myself.
Thanks Chiba... Everyone...

Okay! Let's toss Kiryu-san into the
air to celebrate becoming Onomichi's best!
Yeah! Nice!
Toss... Me?

Yeah! We're Onomichi's strongest now, y'know!?
That pretty much means we're champions!

And when it comes to champions...
Y'gotta toss the star player into the air!
I'm not sure about that...

You guys are gonna toss Kiryu-san?
You'll be needin' our help, I think.

Tossing Kiryu-san...
Sounds great... Right, Lu-san?
Yeah, Shige-san.
Yeah! Everyone can play their part!
H-Hey, let's rethink this...
Ready? Here we go!
Hurrah! Hurrah! Hurrah!
Ah! We dropped Kiryu-san!
A-Are you all right!?
Aren't you Kanamizawa from Kanamizawa Gorgeous?

Indeed.
I've been looking for you, Kiryu-san.

Looking for me? What do you want?
You want a rematch?
Not quite, this doesn't concern baseball...

Kiryu-san, do you remember what was said the other day?
That your team's "bond" is what was important for victory...
Well... Yeah, I guess I said something like that.

I figured I should learn about such a bond,
so I'm thinking about joining your team.

Join my team?
You want in the Setouchi Warriors?

No, I heard that you lead an organization
called the Kiryu Clan...
That's the team I desire to join.

Join the Kiryu Clan? Are you sure about that?
Our battles are nothing like baseball...
I don't mind. All the better, in fact.

I'd like to work under you and study these
bonds to carry over the lessons to baseball.

So I'll be joining you whether you like it or
not. The pleasure is mine, Kiryu-san.

Uh... Sure...
Good to have you?

Hm? Isn't that Hatakeyama-san?
He seems kinda down.
Why the long sigh, Hatakeyama-san?

Well, it ain't much to speak of, but,
I jus' had somethin' real precious stolen from me.

Something was stolen...
You mean by thieves?

A thief...?
I s'pose y'could say that.

You want to talk about it?
Why don't we head into the bar?

Okay, if it ain't a bother to ya.
I feel kinda bad about it.
Welcome Kiryu-san, Hatakeyama-san.

Gen-san just wandered in, too. 
Shall I start pouring?

Hm? What's wrong, Hatakeyama-san?
Y'seem kinda down.

True, you're not yourself today.
Somethin' amiss?
Well... Y'see...

Hmm, I didn't add to the conversation
and it ended awkwardly.

They're still in the bar.
I should clear my head and get back in there.

Hatakeyama-san is going to spy on his daughter.
I'm a little worried...

His daughter's going on a date at La Pente. 
Maybe I should check up on the guy.

I'm worried about Hatakeyama-san. 
I should check La Pente just in case.

Hatakeyama-san should be spying on
his daughter at La Pente right now.
I'll come back later.

Yo, Hatakeyama-san. 
How's it going?
Kiryu-san...? Why're y'here?

Couldn't let you get your daughter's
boyfriend's blood on your hands.

I said I wouldn't do anything like that.
'Sides, the guy ain't even shown yet.
She's been waitin' a while now.

Ah, so that's your daughter. She seems
pretty happy, despite having to wait.
Hatakeyama! Sorry I'm late!

I'm real sorry. Baseball practice went
long today. Y'okay?
Y-Yeah. I just got here myself, actually.

Oh, really? I'm glad I got here
just in time, then.

"Just in time," he says. 
She's been waiting half an hour!
He'll pay fer wasting her time...

Relax, your daughter doesn't seem
to mind. It looks fine.
Let's just stay quiet for now.

Well, let's get started. This one is
real hard, can y'make sense of it?

Which one? Oh, that. Here, you
gotta use the Pythagorean theorem.
Ohh, I think I get it!
They're just studying.

Whew, thanks fer the help. Hatakeyama,
you're a smart cookie.

I think they're just study partners?
It looks pretty innocent to me.
Hmm, maybe I overthought it.

Why'd y'start studying, anyway?
I thought baseball was all you cared about.

Because... With grades like mine, there's
no way I'll get into the same college as you...

Have y'talked to your father yet?
'Bout college n' all that...

No... I haven't mentioned college...
Or you for that matter...

No problem. If it's hard to talk to
him, maybe I could go with.

Ya think he'll flip out and be all
like, "You'll never take my daughter!"

Haha, my dad's real nice,
I don't think it'll come to that.

I just haven't been able to talk to him
lately. I need t'tell him about us.

Yeah, an' I need t'study harder so
your dad won't worry 'bout us.

And baseball too, right?
I hope you guys win next year.

Yeah! Next homer I hit is
gonna be just fer you, Hatakeyama!

Oh really now?
I'll wait for it then! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Thanks fer doin' that, Kiryu-san.

Nah, I didn't do a thing.
You okay though?

I always thought o' my daughter as a
little girl I'd be protectin' forever...

But I was wrong. A girl becomes a
woman, and she's gotta leave the nest...

I pretended it weren't natural at all,
and I worked myself all into a tizzy...

I gotta let my little girl grow up.
I'm such a loser.

I guess I knew all that deep down,
but bein' a father's real rough.

Heh, maybe you're right, but your
daughter hasn't left home yet.

You should appreciate the time you
have with her. Every moment counts.

Yeah, yer right. I gotta have a sit
down with her.

I'll invite that Satoshi kid for
oysters or somethin'.

Good idea. From what little I saw,
he seems to be a good kid.
Well, I gotta get t'opening my shop.

Thanks for everything, Kiryu-san. 
Let's meet up at my place or the bar!
Letting her grow up, huh?

Have a great talk with your girl.
Good luck, Hatakeyama-san.

And? How'd that talk with your
daughter go?
Yeah, we finally had that chat.
That Satoshi kid ain't half bad either.
Nice. So you're on good terms now?

Yeah. 'Sides, a parent's got a responsibility
to see their kids grow up proper.

By the way... Word has it you're a
ball player, Kiryu-san. That true?
Yeah, but it's just recreational.
D'ya think a guy like me could play for ya then?
Huh? Where's this coming from?

Well, my daughter seems t'be pretty
into ball players, so...

Heh, you're trying to look cool
for your daughter?

Is that so bad? 'Sides, it'll give me
somethin' to talk to Satoshi about.

Of course you can play.
Let's impress those kids together.

Thanks! Lookin' forward to the
next game, Kiryu-san!

Oh, Kiryu-san!
Are y'headed to the bar?

If you are, we should go together.
I wanted to talk to you about something.
Sure, let's go.
Sorry, I'm a little busy right now...

Oh okay. Well, I'll be at the bar,
so come talk to me later!
Sure, I will.

I remember Akiyoshi-san wanted to
talk about something at the bar.
I should go in.
No, it sounded like it'd be a long talk...
So what did you want to talk about?
Oh, can you talk right now?

They're still in the bar. I should
clear my head and get back in there.

I'll go home and get ready t'head to
the reunion. Thanks, Kiryu-san.
Yeah, good luck.

Oh, Kiryu-san!
Is Akiyoshi-kun already gone?

Yeah, he just left. 
What's the matter?

He forgot his wallet. What should I do?
I can't leave the bar...

Let me give it to him. 
I'm sure he hasn't gotten too far.

Really!? You'd do that? He lives by
the shrine, so head up that way.

I should get Akiyoshi-san's wallet
back to him. He lives near the shrine.

Hm? That's Akiyoshi-san...
What is he doing up there?

Oh, Kiryu-san.
Something wrong?
Here, you forgot this.

Oh, guess I left it at the bar...
Thanks, sorry for the hassle.

What are you doing here?
Weren't you going to your reunion?

Well... I was still kinda dwelling
on the memory of my teacher...

T'be honest, even after I graduated
from the school, I'd go back n' visit.

Yeah, I used t'play baseball, and whenever
I'd go back, I'd brag about winning.
Heh, typical of a high school athlete.

But we lost the regionals, and to make
matters worse, it was a homer off my pitch...
